parameters.content:
## Prism 10 - Outlook Mail Service
Read-only mail: list / search / thread. Gated by resolved tenant context; returns the standard Prism envelope. Inputs: organizationId, userId, supabaseUrl, fallback context, scope (list|search|thread), query, limit.
